data.summary: The Bürgeramt of Stadt Musterstadt confirms an appointment for Mara Beispiel on 12.05.2026 at 09:30 (Bürgeramt Mitte, Schalter 4) to apply for a passport (Reisepass), case number T-2026-044817. A fee of €70.00 is due at the appointment.
data.explanation: This letter confirms a booked appointment at the citizens' office (Bürgeramt) to apply for a passport. Bring your current ID, a biometric passport photo and €70.00 (cash or card) to the appointment. If you cannot make it, cancel the appointment online rather than simply not showing up, so the slot can be given to someone else. No response or paperwork is needed before the appointment itself.
